title: Counting the Days of Cover Remaining on a Released Policy
content:
The days of cover remaining on a policy of the Travel Protection Plans, when cover is given up, are counted
from the day after the release, and whether the last date of the journey is itself counted turns on whether the
journey has begun.

## The three readings

| The journey on the day cover is given up | The days of cover remaining |
|---|---|
| It has not begun, and it has not ended | Counted from the day after cover is given up to the last date of the journey, both counted |
| It has begun and has not ended | Counted from the day after cover is given up to the last date of the journey, that last date not counted |
| Neither of those | Counted as the whole of the days of cover bought |

## The counts compared on hypothetical dates

A journey runs from the 10th to the 19th. Cover given up on the 4th, before the journey has begun, gives a count
from the 5th to the 19th with both counted, which is 15 days. Cover given up on the 14th, the journey having
begun and not ended, gives a count from the 15th to the 19th with the 19th not counted, which is 4 days. Cover
given up on the 25th, the journey having ended, falls to the third reading, and the days of cover remaining are
counted as the whole of the days of cover bought.
